metadata.title: GitOps change-control and drift evidence components

components.title: gitops
components.description: GitOps workflow whose merged, reviewed pull requests are the change-control evidence and whose continuous reconciliation is the drift evidence for the mapped controls.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Every platform change is a reviewed, approved, merged pull request.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: fabric evidence verifies a pull request is an attributable, time-stamped, approved and merged authorized change.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Running cluster state continuously reconciles to the validated state held in Git.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: fabric drift confirms each Argo CD application is Synced, evidencing the system remains in its qualified state.

control-implementations.description: GitOps change control and drift detection for the pharma MES baseline.

implemented-requirements.description: Changes are made only through a defined, controlled procedure: a reviewed, approved, merged pull request.
The system is continuously evaluated to confirm it remains in a valid state: GitOps reconciliation flags any drift from the validated state in Git.
